basics.name: Mark Cheli
basics.label: Director, Product Operations & Strategy — Onshape at PTC
basics.summary: I steer how Onshape's R&D organization plans, measures and builds: the operating cadence, the adoption of AI across product development, the analytics leadership plans against, and the strategy work that sets direction. I am a builder by nature who now spends most days steering the organization — and I still prototype the answer before asking for it. Thirteen years at PTC from intern to director, including engineering teams of 35+ and a 40-person training-products organization. At home: a 40-container homelab and the apps that run on it.

work.name: PTC — Onshape
work.summary: Run the team that decides how Onshape's R&D organization plans, measures and builds. I own the operating cadence (annual epic planning, reviews, tech-debt planning), lead the move to AI-assisted software development, and own the product analytics that leadership and go-to-market plan against. Hands-on where it is faster: I write the first version of internal tools myself.
highlights: Leading Onshape's move to AI-assisted development: the agentic-harness guidelines engineers follow, the evaluation of Claude over AWS Bedrock for 1,000+ users, MCP servers that put the data warehouse and data dictionary in front of every agent, and the governance and budget model for AI tooling across PTC.

Own the R&D operating cadence — annual epic planning, planning reviews, tech-debt planning — and the strategy work around it: the product-led growth discovery program, the financial case for Onshape Government, and the API quota and rate-limit policy tied to plan tiers.
Built and run the product analytics platform the organization plans against (AWS Redshift, dbt, Prefect, Streamlit, Looker), from signup funnels to API usage.
Run localization operations for an 11-locale product: translation-management vendor selection and renegotiation, the XLIFF/TBX pipeline, a 1,300-term glossary.
Still ship production code: internal Flask services connecting Onshape to Salesforce, billing and the warehouse; a Python admin library; the internal product and admin portals.
Interim Director of Business Operations for the Onshape business unit in 2022 (lead routing, CPQ, executive dashboards). Hire and manage a product-ops/analytics team, developers and interns.
